title: Storyright
intro: An AI-assisted writing editor that understands your unique style, makes suggestions to maintain your voice, prose, and story.

sections.title: Just write.
sections.caption: Write your story free from distraction – let it flow uninterrupted. No suggested edits will be surfaced until you’re ready to review.

sections.title: Review & Edit.
sections.caption: When you’re ready, hit the review button. Your personalized AI will review for style & voice consistency, story structure cohesion, and pacing.

sections.title: Focus mode.
sections.caption: Focus on editing one suggestion at a time, or dismiss the suggestion. Hit done to lock in the change.

sections.title: All your stories.
sections.caption: The AI assistant will maintain story details and style within each project, while also making suggestions on how to keep your unique voice across all.
